howBytesWereMeasured: IDENTIFIERS: sha256sum on disk; `git cat-file blob <sha>:<path>` for historical bytes. Page counts and metadata from pdfinfo; delivered text from `pdftotext -layout` page by page with -f/-l. Widget enumeration (field type, /Ff, /Rect, page, /MK /CA, /AP keys, /A, /F) and active-content enumeration by a pdf-lib 1.17.1 parser walking the indirect-object table, not by regex, because the SOURCE pdfs store objects in compressed object streams that a byte scan cannot see. PIXEL MEASUREMENT: `pdftoppm -gray -r 600 -f N -l N <pdf> <stem>` writing P5 PGM DIRECTLY -- never -png, so the -gray-PNG-is-RGB trap cannot arise: the reader asserts the P5 magic and reads the single-channel plane with numpy. Dark = grey < threshold of 255; every count published at 128, 160 and 200 because the buttons carry a grey fill that only the higher thresholds see. Rendered WITH annotations by default; `-hide-annotations` used only as a labelled control and always named as such. Scope for the caption measurement is each source widget's own /Rect, mapped to the delivered page through the packet's component order, converted at 600/72 px per pt with the PDF's bottom-up y inverted to image rows. Every render deleted immediately after measurement; nothing larger than two 600 dpi pages held at once.

findings.where: filing-instructions.md, sentence 3; and the absence of any fee-exemption sentence in participant-instructions.md
findings.what: The delivered filing instruction states: 'The committed route record identifies no fee-waiver treatment for this certification.' The committed route record states the opposite. legal-design-track-registry.json, track ky_expungement_certification, rules.feeWaiver reads: 'AOC-RU-009 refers on its face to an exemption of fees if applicable. The criteria are not published and are recorded as an open question.' The same sentence is entry 8 of the manifest's own requiredBeforeFiling array for packetSetId ky_expungement_certification-set.
findings.whyThisIsAFailureAndNotAWordingQuibble: The record carries this as a RELEASE BLOCKER whose affectedElement is participant_instructions: 'Whether the Administrative Office of the Courts waives the $40 certification fee on indigency, and on what criteria. AOC-RU-009 refers to an exemption of fees if applicable but the form and the AOC's published process do not state who qualifies or how to ask.' The packet converts an open, release-blocking question into a settled negative, in the participant-facing artifact the blocker names. And it does so while the participant is holding a form that says otherwise: the delivered page itself prints, in the issuer's own words, 'I have provided the basic information necessary to qualify for record processing and exemption of fees - if applicable.' A participant who cannot pay $40 reads the packet saying there is no waiver and the form in their hand saying there may be one. This is the class where a delivered artifact makes a false statement about its own controlling record.
findings.whatWouldSatisfyIt: The record's own sentence, or a sentence that does not deny what the record leaves open. Not this lane's to write.

'The 30-day filing window has run before the participant could file.' -- absent. The guidance states the window twice ('within 30 days of receipt') and never says what to do when it has passed.
findings.andOneMore: The record's postGenerationHandoffs entry reads 'Processing takes roughly four to five months. The packet waits on the certification; the participant is told to expect that and is reminded when the 30-day filing window opens.' The record says in terms that the participant IS TOLD. The guidance tells them the opposite-flavoured thing -- 'There is no waiting period to request the certification' -- and sets no expectation for the four-to-five-month processing time at all. A participant is left to think a request they mail this week produces a certification that must be filed within 30 days, with nothing said about the four to five months in between.
findings.contrast: Not a standard this lane invented for Kentucky. The sibling family in this same return, il-cannabis-vacate-set, carries a 'Stop and get help' section holding all four of ITS record's declared conditions.

findings.whyItMatters: The delivered 'Required before sending' section lists exactly two items, the SSN and the DLN. AOC-RU-009's own optional Additional Information box is the field that consumes those facts, and the packet refuses it as optional without ever telling the participant what would go in it or where to get it.
